spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sorrowing, sorrowful.
n. (-नं)
Sorrow, grief, grieving.
E.
शुच to grieve, aff. युच् or ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be grieved or lamented, what may or ought to be.
E.
शुच to be sad, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sorrowful, afflicted.
E.
शुचि to grieve, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be grieved for, lamentable.
E.
शुच to grieve, तव्य aff.

ind.
Grieving or having grieved for.
E.
शुचि to lament, क्त्वा aff.

m. (-शः)
Fire or its deity.
E.
शोचिस् light, and केश hair, having locks of flame.

n. (-चिः)
Light, lustre, radiance, flame.
E.
शुच to be or make pure, Uṇādi aff. इसि.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
1 To be lamented or bewailed.
2 To be cleansed or purified.
E.
शुच to grieve, यत् aff.

m. (-कः)
A low man.
E.
शोच्य to be purified (from), कन् aff.
